name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse-Grip Row
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a moderate incline and lie chest down with feet braced.
Hold dumbbells hanging beneath your shoulders with an underhand palms-forward grip.
Pull your elbows back close to your ribs until the dumbbells reach beside your waist.
Squeeze your back briefly, then extend your arms slowly to lower the dumbbells.
tips: Keep your wrists straight as you pull.
Keep your chest planted on the pad instead of lifting your torso with momentum.
